headline: Admin User Management — /admin/users full implementation
description:
Objective

Implement the admin user management section at /admin/users. The admin panel card currently shows coming-soon. Deliver user listing (paginated + search), user detail view, deactivation action, and display name update — all behind admin auth gate.

Scope

  • GET /api/admin/users — list with pagination/search
  • GET /api/admin/users/[id] — user detail
  • PATCH /api/admin/users/[id] — update display name
  • POST /api/admin/users/[id]/deactivate — soft deactivate
  • RSC page at /admin/users
  • Client component for table and actions
  • Extend DrizzleUserRepository with listAll and deactivate
  • Extend UserRepository contract
  • Unit tests for route handlers
  • Feature doc: 35 - Admin User Management.md

Acceptance Criteria

  • pnpm typecheck passes
  • pnpm lint --fix passes
  • Unit tests pass
  • Admin users list loads real data from DB
  • Unauthorized access returns 403
